verdict.rationale: Lium publishes GPU rental prices with no account or sales contact. llms.txt points users to the public prices with no account needed, a public price feed is offered as CSV at lium.io/pricing.csv, and a public nodes feed lists every rentable GPU node with no key or signup. Billing is documented as hourly price prorated per second. Missing for 10: an explicitly evidenced human-readable pricing page showing a per-GPU-hour price for each GPU type, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the published prices.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see the published per-GPU-hour price for every GPU type on a public pricing page without talking to sales

citations.quote: read the public prices below, no account.
Price feed, CSV | https://lium.io/pricing.csv | spreadsheets, data warehouses
Every rentable GPU node on Lium in one JSON call. No key, no signup.
You pay **per second**: `hourly price × seconds / 3600`, with no minimum.
